findings.description: Recommendation for "Non-text Content Missing Text Alternatives" (Priority 2) is generic – it instructs to add alt text to every informative image without referencing a specific selector, page, or count from the audit data.

Recommendation for "Interactive Elements Missing Name, Role, or Value" (Priority 3) lacks any specific element selector, URL, or instance count; it merely advises giving every custom control an accessible name.

Recommendation for "Info and Relationships Not Programmatically Determined" (Priority 4) is a domain‑level instruction to expose structure without citing particular form fields or labels identified in the audit.
Recommendation for "No Bypass Mechanism for Repeated Blocks" (Priority 5) prescribes adding a skip link or landmark but does not reference any specific element, page, or count from the findings.
Recommendation for "Heading Hierarchy Skips Levels" (Priority 6) is generic – it instructs to order headings without skipping levels, with no selector or instance data.

Recommendation for "Semantic Structure (Naked Containers)" (Priority 7) advises replacing landmark containers and adding meaningful class names but does not point to any specific element, page, or count from the audit.
Recommendation for "Structured Data Property Gaps" (Priority 9) instructs to add missing Schema.org properties without referencing particular entities, URLs, or counts identified in the audit data.
